answer: At dawn, every agent locks a slashable bond under one operator identity, and payout is proportional to that bond, not to the number of keys that vote. A Sybil farmer who forks one wallet into a thousand agents merely re-pledges the same collateral, so its weight stays flat; a detected clone burns the whole bond into the honest pool. Reaching the summit of the reward table therefore requires fresh, forfeitable capital per extra vote, and a walnut of stake cannot be counted twice just because it is split.
